_readme: Gate 8's REQUIRED 'before' capture. The gate's own words: memory and statistics must
render in the Files app with 'the same numbers the old Settings page produced, captured
**before** removal and compared after'. Removal has not happened yet, so this file is the
only chance to take it -- once settingsRegistry loses pageId:'memory' there is nothing left
Measured 2026-08-31 through the running app's debug bridge (read-only; both probe globals
deleted afterwards; the app was NOT navigated, because it is another track's live
instrument -- every value below comes from the same call the page itself makes, not from
TRAP for whoever compares: four of these are LIVE MACHINE STATE and will not reproduce.
`freemem`, `used`, `quota` and every `stats.*` figure move on their own -- freemem by the
second, and the stats counters every time the user reads or watches anything. Compare the
ids), and compare the volatile ones only for shape: same source, same units, same
ordering, non-null. A Files-app panel that reports a DIFFERENT freemem is correct; one
that reports null, or bytes where the page showed a percentage, is not.

method.note: /eval is synchronous and a promise serializes to {} -- the result is parked on a window global by call 1 and read by call 2. See memory 'bridge-eval-is-synchronous'.

_stable: the six ids and their order

knownWords._note: A measured zero, not a missing reader. It agrees with the Notebook's own `known: 0` stream count taken in the same session (gate 7's table), so two independent readers report the same empty store. A Files-app panel showing anything other than 0 here is reporting a different store.
